title: Disney reportedly seeks $10 million for 30-second ads in Super Bowl LXI

facts.fact: Disney has told advertisers it believes they should pay $10 million for a 30-second ad in the 2027 telecast of Super Bowl LXI, according to Variety citing four people with knowledge of negotiations.
